bundle.shortDescription: Universal game library organizer and launcher
bundle.longDescription: Universal Game Launcher is a privacy-first, cross-platform game launcher and library organizer. It consolidates games across Steam, GOG, Epic Games, itch.io, emulators, and local installations with rich artwork, provider fallbacks, and direct launch support.
